works.title: Release It! Design and Deploy Production-Ready Software, 2nd ed.
works.note: Stability-patterns canon: names and teaches Circuit Breaker, Fail Fast, Let It Crash, Timeout as production error-handling mechanisms.

works.title: Patterns for Fault Tolerant Software
works.note: The fault-tolerance pattern catalog: names 13 of this route's error-detection/recovery/mitigation elements outright.

works.title: Fluent C: Principles, Practices, and Patterns
works.note: Modern catalog of C error-handling idioms: Cleanup Record, Goto Cleanup, Guard Clause, Log Errors, Return Status Code, Samurai Principle, Special Return Value, pointer checks.

works.title: Preschern EuroPLoP/PLoP pattern-paper series (Patterns for Returning Error Information in C; ...)

works.title: Design Patterns for Embedded Systems in C
works.note: Embedded safety/reliability pattern chapter names One's Complement Data Storage, Smart Data, CRC, Protected Single Channel, Dual Channel, Watchdog.

works.title: Real-Time Design Patterns; Doing Hard Time; Real-Time UML

works.title: Better Embedded System Software

works.title: Secure Coding in C and C++, 2nd ed.
works.note: Teaches stack-smashing mitigations (canaries/StackGuard lineage) and canonicalize-then-validate for file-name and input handling.

works.title: The CERT C Coding Standard, 2nd ed.
works.note: Rule-level treatments: sensitive-data zeroization (MSC06/memset_s) and canonicalization before validation (FIO02-C).

works.title: IEC 61508:2010 — Functional safety of E/E/PE safety-related systems
works.note: Part 7 technique catalog defines program sequence monitoring, self-tests (BIST), diverse/N-version programming, and recovery blocks as normative safety techniques.

works.title: ISO 26262:2018 — Road vehicles — Functional safety
works.note: Defines and mandates the safe state concept for automotive fault reactions.

works.title: Linux kernel coding style
works.note: Chapter 7 codifies centralized function exit via goto for cleanup — the canonical goto-cleanup statement.

works.title: Refactoring: Improving the Design of Existing Code
works.note: 'Replace Nested Conditional with Guard Clauses' is the naming treatment of the guard clause.

works.title: Patterns for Time-Triggered Embedded Systems

works.title: P1028 SG14 status_code and standard error object
works.note: Status/result-object design for C++ — the systems-language face of the result type.

works.title: C Interfaces and Implementations
works.note: The Except interface is the canonical worked setjmp/longjmp exception mechanism in C; assertions chapter backs sanity checking.

works.title: Mastering the FreeRTOS Real-Time Kernel

works.title: Making Embedded Systems: Design Patterns for Great Software

works.title: Code Complete, 2nd ed.

works.title: Debugging with GDB, Tenth Edition

notes: All 90 route-r8 elements (error-handling + robustness-security) are covered by >=1 catalog-grade work; no gaps. 20 memberships reuse existing corpus ids; 32 new works (26 verified live, 6 unverified). Systematic blocker: usenix.org and dl.acm.org/IEEE returned 403 on every attempt, leaving provos (privilege separation), stackguard (stack canary), avizienis85, randell75, and huangrejuv unverified — each is either canon-by-reputation or backstopped by a verified/membership work covering the same element (seacordsecure for stack-canary; iec61508 for N-version and recovery blocks). awsbuilders unverified because builder.aws.com renders client-side. Judgment calls: dropped seed Feathers/QuickCheck/Meyer/RFC1982/RFC2308 (no matching elements in this route); dropped Viega-Messier (O'Reilly 403) in favor of verified Oracle Solaris privilege-bracketing doc; Ferraiolo-Kuhn NIST RBAC paper omitted since yoderbarcalow+schumacher cover RBAC at catalog grade (flag for pass-8 merge if another route adds it); brown-out-handling anchored on the verified AVR180 note rather than an unverifiable Ganssle chapter claim. Element-side density: hanmer alone anchors 13 elements; the Yoder-Barcalow/Schumacher pair covers the 7-pattern application-security cluster in naming + book form.
